description: This file defines a PHP class 'Marketing' within the 'Opencart\Catalog\Model\Marketing' namespace. The class provides methods for retrieving marketing data by code and adding marketing reports, serving as part of the OpenCart e-commerce platform's API model for marketing-related functionalities.

classes.name: Marketing
classes.description: A model class for handling marketing-related database operations within the OpenCart platform.

methods.name: getMarketingByCode
methods.description: Retrieves marketing information from the database based on a specific code.

methods.name: addReport
methods.description: Adds a marketing report entry to the database, including IP address and country information.
